hotelOccupancyNotes: Rough estimate of how full downtown hotels were, as it bears on each day (within about 10 points). Each day blends 60% of the night before with 40% of that night. Nights are built from the day of the week, the season, meetings in town, the night before cruise departures and a few visitor-heavy nights (Bruno Mars, the YMCA assembly, the Saints-Raiders weekend, WEFTEC). Southern Decadence nights use Fox 8's reported occupancy (over 60% Fri, nearly 80% Sat, about 60% Sun). The season level is August's, calibrated to CoStar; CoStar's September figure isn't out yet. The total is the month's average.
